name: Elizabeth of Russia
contribution: Empress of Russia from 1741 until her death in 1762.
legacy: She was the last agnatic member of the House of Romanov to reign over the Russian Empire.

checks.lead: Elizabeth or Elizaveta Petrovna (Russian: Елизаве́та Петро́вна; 29 December [O.S. 18 December] 1709 – 5 January 1762 [O.S. 25 December 1761]) was Empress of Russia from 1741 until her death in 1762. She is notable among Russian monarchs for her decision not to execute a single person during her reign, her numerous construction projects, and her strong opposition to Prussian policies. She was the last person on the agnatic line of the Romanovs as her nephew ascended, thus creating the house of Holstein-Gottorp-Romanov.
